subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: How should maintainers split this bundled report between core TUI/Gateway session semantics and external openclaw-weixin ownership?
rationale: One automated fix cannot safely cover core session routing, external WeChat runtime state, and product-level background-event/activity semantics without a maintainer-owned boundary decision.

options.title: Split and route subproblems
options.body: Keep the umbrella open while focused issues or PRs own sessions_send, TUI session defaults, meaningful-activity ordering, and WeChat plugin-boundary proof separately.

options.title: Keep as umbrella pending live repro
options.body: Use this issue as a human-owned tracker until maintainers reproduce the WeChat and flood/deadlock paths on current main.

options.title: Close only after linked fixes land
options.body: Close this issue after focused linked fixes or explicit decisions cover every reported behavior with current-main proof.

recommendation.title: Split and route subproblems
recommendation.body: Keep the umbrella open while focused issues or PRs own sessions_send, TUI session defaults, meaningful-activity ordering, and WeChat plugin-boundary proof separately.
